items.t: 2027 GRIs: 5.9% average again at both carriers
items.body: UPS announced its 2027 GRI on Oct. 23, 2026, effective Dec. 21, 2026. FedEx announced on Sept. 18, 2026, effective Jan. 4, 2027. The year before, UPS announced Oct. 31, 2025 for Dec. 22, 2025, and FedEx announced Sept. 12, 2025 for Jan. 5, 2026. FedEx GRIs averaged 4.9% for 2018 through 2021, 5.9% for 2022, 6.9% for 2023, and 5.9% from 2024 through 2027; UPS's 2018 GRI was 4.9%, announced Oct. 25, 2017 for Dec. 24, 2017.

items.t: USPS: 5.9% and an 11% fuel surcharge filed for Jan. 17, 2027
items.body: USPS filed on Nov. 12, 2026 for a 5.9% average increase on domestic shipping services and an 11% fuel surcharge replacing the 8% charge that took effect Apr. 26, 2026, both effective Jan. 17, 2027, with the surcharge pending PRC review. For Jan. 18, 2026, announced Nov. 14, 2025, Priority Mail rose about 6.6% and Ground Advantage about 7.8%; in January 2021 USPS noted it had no fuel surcharge. Mid-year changes now recur: Parcel Select +25% in July 2024, Priority Mail +6.3% and Ground Advantage +7.1% in July 2025, and Ground Advantage Commercial +11.8% on average in July 2026.

items.t: UPS fuel tables changed five times in 2026; FedEx adjusted Nov. 9
items.body: UPS changed its domestic fuel tables effective Jan. 5, Mar. 9, Aug. 10, Nov. 2 and Nov. 16, 2026; the Nov. 16 change, announced Nov. 12, adds 0.50 points per price band. Earlier years had fewer: +1 point on Nov. 15, 2021, +0.50 on Apr. 29, 2024, and +0.50 on Mar. 10, +1.00 on May 26 and +0.75 on Domestic Air on June 23, 2025. UPS's Nov. 2, 2026 table lists Ground at 30.00% for diesel $6.25-$6.34, against UPS and FedEx Ground both at 20% in June 2025, described then as a record; FedEx adjusted domestic tables effective Nov. 9, 2026, size not stated.

items.t: 2026 peak charges are above 2025 levels; UPS adds retail demand tier
items.body: FedEx's Nov. 23 - Dec. 27, 2026 window lists Additional Handling at $11.85 (2025: $10.90), Oversize at $117.25 ($108.50), Ground Residential at $0.80 ($0.65) and Ground Economy at $4.05 ($3.55). UPS's Nov. 22 - Dec. 26, 2026 peak window lists Large Package at $117.50 (2025: $107) and Over Maximum Limits at $590 ($540), and its Nov. 17 update adds a separate Retail Demand Surcharge section, including $0.75 per Ground and Ground Saver package. USPS's 2026 surcharge, Oct. 4, 2026 - Jan. 17, 2027, is stacked on the temporary 8% and adds $0.50 for retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage zones 1-4, 0-3 lb, versus $0.40 in 2025 and none in 2023.

items.t: Size and billing rules for accessorials changed again in 2026
items.body: FedEx (Jan. 12, 2026) and UPS (Jan. 26, 2026, after a postponement from Aug. 17, 2025) moved Additional Handling to a cubic trigger of more than 10,368 cubic inches. Effective Dec. 21, 2026, UPS raises the Additional Handling minimum billable weight from 40 to 50 lb, adds an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers (amount not stated), and applies a 5% fuel surcharge on Small Business Rates alongside a 4.5% increase. USPS cut its dimensional divisor from 166 to 139 on July 12, 2026, with dimensions rounded up to the whole inch; its 2019 change went from 194 to 166, and FedEx and UPS adopted whole-unit rounding on Aug. 18, 2025.

items.t: Per-pound surge fees spread across lanes in 2026
items.body: In 2026 FedEx set $0.50 per lb on exports to Zone K and $0.70 on imports from Zone K from Mar. 5, and $0.36 (priority) and $0.27 (economy) per lb on Vietnam-origin imports from Nov. 2. UPS set $1.34 per lb on U.S.-Middle East shipments from Mar. 22, a $0.23 per lb Surge Emergency Fee from Apr. 19, and, announced Nov. 12, raised the China/Hong Kong/Macau fee from $0.91 to $1.03 per lb effective Nov. 16; the March and April fees have no end date. In 2025 international peak fees ran $0.10 to $0.52 per lb for set windows, and the de minimis suspension of Aug. 29, 2025 brought a UPS Entry Preparation Charge of $10 or $20 per shipment.
